messages:
sara_support: FYI — Cyanwell procurement just replied: they will not accept an invoice until we provide a Procurement Authorization ID (their ProcureLink PA code). They also note the vendor profile is incomplete (missing VAT cert + legal entity). Customer asks us to hold billing. Raising to finance to confirm options. Internal ticket INC-67321.

matt_sales: Ugh, they snuck that in late. Do we have an example PA format? Can we send a proforma now and attach the SOW so their finance team has something to process? cc @finance_kate

finance_kate: We cannot post a final, collectible invoice without the PA. Two paths: (1) customer submits ProcureLink PA (preferred) and we issue normal invoice, or (2) we send a proforma (non-payable) so they can start internal approvals. If proforma, mark as "Pending Procurement Authorization ID — non-billable" and include VAT/tax ID in the header. I can draft the proforma if someone provides the VAT/tax ID and remittance address.

procurement_jane: Also need their requisition number and vendor remittance address. I'll DM a vendor-onboarding checklist we can forward: company legal name, tax/VAT id, remittance address, PO template, and an authorized signatory. If they can supply the PA code (PA-XXXX-YYYY) we can release the invoice.

jordan_cyanwell: Hi — sorry for the delay. I've escalated to Cyanwell procurement. They'll generate PA-2026-88 in ProcureLink and create our vendor profile. ETA ~48 hours. Can you hold invoice issuance until PA is attached? I'll post the PA here when it's available. — Jordan (Cyanwell)

sara_support: Thanks Jordan. We can prepare a proforma in the meantime to help your internal approvals. Note it will be "non-payable" until PA is provided. Shall I prepare and email it to your AP contact?

matt_sales: Yes — prepare the proforma. Include a clear line: "Pending Procurement Authorization ID (PA) — not for payment" and attach the signed SOW and our PO template. Also include an example code format to save back-and-forth.

support-bot: Ticket INC-67321 updated: status -> awaiting-customer-action. Reminder scheduled for 48h.

finance_kate: I'm drafting the proforma now. Draft header for review:

```
Proforma: Redwood Inference -> Cyanwell
Amount: $12,500.00
Note: Pending Procurement Authorization ID (e.g. PA-2026-88). Non-payable until PA provided and vendor profile completed.
```

finance_kate: If the PA doesn't arrive within 72h we will escalate to AE for assistance with procurement. @matt_sales can you confirm this account needs any contract amendment for payment terms?

matt_sales: No contract amendment required; standard net30 applies once PA and vendor setup complete.

sara_support: Closing loop for now — invoice release is on hold until PA or completed vendor onboarding. Will update when PA arrives. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
